summary: Iter 97 · Feb 2026 Tournament Eligibility follow-ups fully verified. Backend: 15/15 pytests green — 5 new (iter97 eligibility-spec + tightened eligible-tournaments buckets) + 10 regression (test_tournament_eligibility.py). Frontend: (1) trn-hero-eligibility-badge renders on /tournaments/{tid} with full text 'U15 · MEN · BORN ≤ 2012-09-01 · BORN ≥ 2010-09-01 · MEDICAL REQ' (uppercase from CSS tracking style, all tokens present). (2) Inline registry cells: all six data-testid families (boob/boa/mp/edu/outmp/medical) present on 17 Inter-Div rows. MM Jagdale Trophy DOB born_on_or_before 2012-09-01 → 2012-08-15 via fill+blur, PATCH 200, persisted after reload, reverted to 2012-09-01 via second PATCH 200. Bhau Nivsarkar Trophy medical_required Yes → No → Yes toggled via click, both PATCH 200, persisted after reload. Registry cleaned; seed tournament removed.
observations: Hero badge text is fully uppercase due to `text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em]` on the span; problem statement acceptance text was mixed-case ('Men', 'born ≤ …', 'Medical Req'). Case-insensitive substring check passes for every required token so functional acceptance is met.

InlineToggleCell wraps `<input type='checkbox'>` inside a `<label>`; the data-testid is on the input. Playwright `label.click()` with `has=` filter throws (locator semantics); direct `input.click(force=True)` toggles reliably.

Seeded MM Jagdale tournament initially threw 500 on GET /api/tournaments/{tid} due to missing required response-model fields (`format`, `tournament_no`). Not a product bug (any real tournament created via wizard has them); just note for future seeding scripts. Also `format` must be from the enum (used 'Multi_Day').
critical_code_review_comments: core/tournament_eligibility.py: _player_dob still has the walrus bug flagged in iter96 — cosmetic only, since players persist dob as ISO string.

routes/tournament_eligibility.py: body_id regex uses raw f-string without re.escape() on body_code — a malicious/malformed code with regex metachars can 500. Low risk (body_code is server-side generated) but worth escaping.

TournamentMasterRegistry saveField optimistically merges the patch into buckets but does NOT reload after success — good UX, but if backend transforms the value (e.g. coerces `null` → ''), the local view can drift until next reload. Confirmed OK for date/number/bool but worth a low-priority note.
test_credentials: persona-chip-secretary (Sanjeev Dua) used for both /tournaments/{tid} and /tournament-master flows.
